title: Next-generation characterization of the Cancer Cell Line Encyclopedia

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《Next-generation characterization of the Cancer Cell Line Encyclopedia》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】Large panels of comprehensively characterized human cancer models, including the Cancer Cell Line Encyclopedia (CCLE), have provided a rigorous framework with which to study genetic variants, candidate targets, and small-molecule and biological therapeutics and to identify new marker-driven cancer dependencies.
